trust.label: Why shop with us
trust.freeCancel: Free cancellation until your order ships

pdp.careGeneric: To keep colour and stretch: rinse in cool fresh water right after the sea or pool, hand wash gently, don't wring, and dry in the shade – never in a dryer.
pdp.fitGeneric: Fits true to size. Between sizes? We recommend sizing up.

shipping.cancel: Free cancellation as long as the order hasn't shipped, right from your account.
shipping.returns: Returns or exchanges within 14 days of delivery.
shipping.hygiene: For hygiene reasons, swimwear can only be returned with the hygiene liner still in place and unworn beyond trying on.

products.activateNoSizes: A product can't be shown in the store without active sizes. Add a size in the product editor.

sizeGuides.title: Size guides
sizeGuides.intro: Each guide has its own page on the site (/size-guide/…) and opens from the "Size guide" link on product pages of the categories linked to it. Link a guide to a category in Categories.
sizeGuides.summary: {tables, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}} · {steps, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} · {tips, plural, one {# tip} other {# tips}}
sizeGuides.deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} size guide? Categories linked to it will no longer show a size guide.
sizeGuides.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first in the tabs.
sizeGuides.isActiveHint: Hidden guides keep their content but don't appear on the site or on product pages.
sizeGuides.imageSectionHint: Shown next to the measuring steps. A tall image (about 2:3) works best.
sizeGuides.imagePending: The new image is uploaded when you save.
sizeGuides.imageHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB.
sizeGuides.imageFailed: Saved, but the image couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.
sizeGuides.tablesHint: Sizes go across the top, one row per measurement. Ranges like 76–81 are shown exactly as typed.
sizeGuides.tableHint: An empty cell shows a dash.
sizeGuides.stepsHint: Numbered steps shown next to the illustration.
sizeGuides.tipsHint: Short lines shown under the steps.
sizeGuides.duplicateSlug: Another size guide already uses this web address.
sizeGuides.invalidContent: Some fields are invalid. Check the highlighted sections.
sizeGuides.fixIssues: Please fix the following before saving:

issues.name: Fill in the name in both languages.
issues.slug: The web address can only use lowercase English letters, digits and dashes (e.g. women).
issues.tableTitle: Every table needs a title in both languages.
issues.columnLabel: Every size column needs a label.
issues.duplicateColumn: A table has the same size twice.
issues.rowLabel: Every table row needs a label in both languages.
issues.stepText: Every step needs a title and an explanation in both languages.
issues.tipText: Every tip needs text in both languages.
